summary: Kimco Realty OP, LLC filed an 8-K on June 15, 2026, solely to disclose the entry into a material definitive agreement for a preferred stock issuance. The filing details the terms of depositary shares representing 7.250% Class N Cumulative Convertible Perpetual Preferred Stock, along with Class L and Class M Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock. No specific price per share, premium, or conversion terms are provided in the excerpt. The agreement creates a direct financial obligation and an unregistered sale of equity securities. This is a routine capital-raising transaction through preferred equity, not a special situation. No advisors or board recommendations are noted, and the focus is on the operational funding of the REIT. Monitor for future pricing and conversion details.
